basic_profile.bio: A sauna enthusiast living in the Pacific Northwest, I have been an active part of the Reddit community for 8 years. My interests revolve around sustainable living, wellness, and the history of sauna culture. I work as an environmental engineer, which fuels my passion for eco-friendly solutions. In my free time, I enjoy tabletop games like Magic: The Gathering and exploring virtual reality sports. I am happily married with two cats named Ember and Blaze. Typically, I browse Reddit during late evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in environmental engineering, which I studied at Oregon State University. I have a deep appreciation for traditional Finnish saunas and have researched extensively into their design and cultural significance. I regularly engage with communities discussing eco-friendly practices and contribute insights on sustainable sauna construction.
